description: List the courses you have starred as favorites; these decide what appears on your dashboard. Read-only. Change them with add_favorite_course and remove_favorite_course.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_favorite_courses
title: List Favorite Courses
